reviewer: Codex source review under maintainer instruction; not a human sign-off
review_method: Public repository opened in Codex web; pinned README, targeted implementation and LICENSE retrieved from public raw URLs and inspected. No upstream code executed.
identity_check: Exact repository owner/name and numeric repository ID checked; similarly named projects not merged by name.
role_findings_zh: 页面候选元素或证据及限定问题进入 TypeSafe System One，Jev 给出目标、动作或语义判断；代码验证返回并由 Playwright 执行。
role_findings_en: Page candidates or evidence and bounded questions go to TypeSafe System One; Jev selects targets, actions or semantic judgments, while code validates responses and Playwright acts.
limitations_zh: 未运行；作者验证边界未由本库实测。支持兼容端点，不代表所有配置均使用 TypeSafe。
limitations_en: Not run; the author’s verification boundaries were not independently tested. Compatible endpoints exist, so not every configuration uses TypeSafe.

sources.inspected_scope: Project purpose, installation, TypeSafe/compatible endpoint boundary and verification claims inspected.
TypeSafeClient setup and systemOne decision call inspected.
Grounded page evidence and semantic question construction inspected.
Apache-2.0 license header and terms inspected; no material copied.
